newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares up on lively foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares up on lively foreign demand.

text.p: Slovenian shares jumped 3.52 percent on Friday pushed up by foreign buying and market participants said further gains were on the cards.

"Investors, especially foreign ones, seem to be buying without limits, while most individual share-owners of newly privatised companies are not willing to sell," said Nina Jarc, a trader at bank Nova Ljubljanska Banka.
* The SBI index rose 44.92 points to 1,322.8.
* Issue A of Drug Company Lek was most actively traded, soaring 8.8 percent to 27,200 tolars on volume of 9,776 shares. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana Newsroom, 386-61-126-3644
